acceptance_criteria: While the camera runs in the gesture view (countdown and recording) the live preview of card NG-42 is shown: the front camera's picture mirrored, the tracked hands drawn with L/R and the shoulders
The preview is closed and gone after each attempt and on every way out; nothing is stored or sent; a bridge without createPreview or a failing preview leaves the view working as before
Every state of the view fits the window from 320x480 to 820x1180 without page scroll, with all buttons at least --tile-min high
goal: Whoever records a gesture in the child's gesture view sees the camera picture with the detected hands, so it is clear where the gesture is captured.
